Deceptive scam support! Mocked with templates and tried to trick me!
I ordered a crystal candelabra lamp (order PO-186-01483704556152325), which arrived completely broken and shattered. What followed was a total nightmare of deceptive practices and mockery by Temu's customer support.First, when I reported the damaged item, the support agent opened a fake claim for "Item not received." Since tracking showed it was delivered to Spain, the system automatically rejected it. This was a deliberate setup to deny my refund.Second, after I protested, they promised a "refund without return" but instead forced a physical return and generated a label for GLS ROMANIA, completely ignoring that my shipping and residence address is in SPAIN! It is logistically impossible to ship broken glass across Europe using an invalid domestic label from another country.For over a week, the supervisor intentionally wasted my time by spamming me with useless automated templates. When I explicitly begged them to stop using templates and look at the country error, they mockingly replied with the exact same template script, word for word. No human empathy, no solutions, just wasting time.Finally, they tried to trick me by sending an email demanding that I cancel the return request and open a new one. This was a pathetic attempt to make me lose my consumer rights. Now, they have simply CLOSED the ticket without resolving anything.This is an absolute scam. I have already escalated this fraudulent behavior to my bank for a chargeback and filed an official case with the OCU Consumer Protection in Spain. Avoid Temu at all costs!
